headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The Yankees edged out the Braves in a closely contested matchup, with Gerrit Cole leading the way for New York. In other action, the Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Red Sox, with Gage Jump pitching 6.0 innings and striking out 11 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. The Milwaukee Brewers also placed Cooper Pratt on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The MLB trade market was active, with the Kansas City Royals acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Gage Jump leading the way on the mound. Jump pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 11 batters while allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels, securing a 7-0 victory. Xavier Edwards led the Angels' offense with 2 hits and 3 RBIs, while Sandy Alcantara pitched a strong 7 innings for the Marlins, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the final score 4-3. Impact players for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
